messages:
ran: quick heads-up: planning to unpin SDK v3.2 in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. we've hit a quant-kernel selector regression that impacts qv2-retro models. plan is to sticky-pin runtime for that model-group until the microkernel patch lands. need owners and rollback gates.
sylvia: ok. propose staggered rollout but with a narrower first slice: 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 25m so we can validate telemetry faster. keep qv2-retro on pinned runtime.
omar: agree. i'll add a hold for qv2-retro and create an explicit routing rule to runtime 2.14.1+kv-fix. opsctl commands i will run: `opsctl hold add model-group qv2-retro --reason "selector-regression" --until 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z` and `opsctl pin create --type runtime --target "runtime:2.14.1+kv-fix" --scope "model-group:qv2-retro" --ttl 36h`
kevin: infra to reserve 2 canary pods in eu-west and 1 in eu-central for warmup. healthcheck target 250rps. i'll publish the runbook link in a min.
sre-oncall: monitoring owners ack. suggested rollback thresholds: 1) 5xx spike >0.4% over baseline, 2) p95 generation latency +25% for qv2-retro after routing, 3) token-error-rate doubling or OOMs, 4) eval drift on canary-core-10 >3.5%. if any hit, abort and re-pin. paging to #incidents for alerting.
docs-bot: draft internal release note ready. public blurb suggestion under Known Issues: "qv2-retro models temporarily routed to runtime v2.14.1+kv-fix due to quant/kernel selector regression; SDK v3.2 unpin staged for non-qv2 traffic."
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin eu-west @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Rollout slices: 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 25m. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Escape hatch: `deploy rollback --job sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason telemetry-trigger`
ran: owners checklist before 23:00: 1) holdlist present (omar) 2) runtime pin active (omar) 3) canaries reserved/warming (kevin) 4) metrics+eval alerts configured (sre-oncall) 5) release notes drafted (docs-bot) 6) on-call paged (sre-oncall). please ack.
omar: holdlist + runtime pin done. opsctl output: `OK: hold hl-7752 created; OK: pin id=pin-7752 created target=runtime:2.14.1+kv-fix scope=model-group:qv2-retro ttl=36h`
kevin: canaries warming now, ETA ~7m. capacity reserved.
deploy-bot: started: SDK unpin slice 5%. canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. monitoring links posted.
sre-oncall: pod-2 healthy -> advancing to 50% per plan. no alerts so far. continuing eval runs every 5m.
sylvia: good. reminder: if rollback happens, docs-bot will post an incident note and support must be notified with the rollback playbook.
docs-bot: noted. customer-facing note template standing by.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:02:42Z. no rollback triggered.
ran: follow-up actions: 1) keep pinned runtime until patch merged + 24h stabilization 2) run compatibility smoke across all model groups in 48h 3) postmortem stub created linking to PR for the kernel selector fix. closing thread.
